lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows. The anterior region posterior to the gills shows smaller, more densely packed blobs, while the central flank exhibits larger blobs with greater spatial separation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance intersect the horizontal rows, creating a grid-like pattern with high-intensity blobs located at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly across the visible surface, with higher density toward the ventral attachment point.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of elongated, low-luminance objects is visible immediately ventral to the pectoral fin, indicating the presence of commensal organisms.
